title: fix(types): only allow `null` for parent if widget is an index
body:
**Summary**

The only case init is called with `parent: null`  is inside InstantSearch for the main index, and thus it shouldn't leak every widget implementation

**Result**

the types for `widget.init` and `getWidgetRenderState` no longer accept `null` for `parent`

As this is only types and fairly internal, as well as the behaviour of calling a widget with parent: null isn't useful, this isn't a breaking change
